review_candidates.title: Ops & Product Builder – Health Services, Belgium
review_candidates.description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. 🤹 OPERATIONS AT ALAN Behind Alan's performance lies an Operations team that is anything but back-office. At Alan, Ops is a strategic function: we define the vision, build the systems, and own the outcomes that make our insurance and healthcare products work at scale. As a Ops & Product Builder, you will own some of the most critical and ambiguous challenges in the company. You will shape strategy, drive cross-functional alignment, and build solutions with lasting impact on Alan's P&L and member experience. You’ll be joining 80+ talented, committed, passionate Ops team members working globally on all our services. You’ll be among the team mates structuring this community. Our health services in Belgium is where you can make a difference In Belgium, our ambition is to build the most integrated care journey in the country. Prevention, care and insurance should work as one, so that every member has a health partner before they get sick, not just after. We particularly you start by bringing the full ecosystem of our health services to life for our Belgian customers ⭐️ THE CHALLENGE We are looking for entrepreneurs in the mindset with a strong operational background to disrupt (and not only upgrade) the way we traditionally think about insurance or healthcare, and deeply re-engineer the experience we offer to our members . We move fast and are proud to tackle big problems! One of our core value is ownership : we expect you to tackle Alan's problems from end to end with a long-term focus, acting on the behalf of the entire Company, never saying “it’s not my job” and being accountable for your actions. Specifically here: Belgian healthcare is built to react. You get sick, then you get care. Prevention is the exception, and people are left to find their way between GPs, specialists, mutualities and insurers. In France, we’ve shown it can work differently. Mo, our AI medical assistant, answers health questions 24/7. The Shop delivers health products at zero out-of-pocket. Alan Precision makes advanced prevention accessible through blood tests and health plans. Occupational health brings prevention into working life. It all lives in one app. Now we’re building it in Belgium, and you’re the one who makes it happen. Here are some examples of missions that you could lead: Launch Mo in Belgium Bring our AI medical assistant to Belgium in French and Dutch, with Belgian doctors shaping its answers and taking over when a human is needed. Advanced prevention for everyone: Generalise advanced blood tests paired with AI health plans into a service every member can easily access. That means building the network of clinical labs, pharmacies and care providers behind Alan Precision. Prevention programmes for unmet health needs: Spot the gaps in today’s care (weight loss, sleep, women’s health etc) and turn them, with health professionals and product teams, into programmes members love. A health partner for every workplace: Reinvent occupational health and Health At Work, a channel that reaches a huge share of Belgian workers but struggle to deliver the right impact on prevention. Design the model and take it from idea to launch. This is a 0-to-1 role. You’ll have the autonomy of a founder and the backing of a €800M+ ARR company. What you build will change how hundreds of thousands of people in Belgium look after their health. ⭐️ IF YOU HAVE SOME OF THE FOLLOWING, YOU MAY BE A GREAT FIT ⭐️ 6+ years in operations, product or entrepreneurship, ideally including launching new services Fluent in English and French or Dutch (both is a strong plus) You have a high level of structure and strong analytical skills (including Sql fluency for data analysis) You’ve taken a product or service from zero to scale and owned high-ambiguity, high-impact initiatives You set clear vision and roadmaps, lead product reviews and drive make-or-buy decisions You build and run key partnerships autonomously (providers, pharmacies, labs, health-tech) You’re strong on AI and automation You’re a strong mentor who makes the people around you better You know, or will quickly learn, how Belgian healthcare works: mutualities, practitioners, reimbursement, regulation For this role we are looking to hire within the D–F level range, based in Brussels. 🎯 IMPORTANT NOTE: WE HIRE PEOPLE, NOT ROLES. If you’re excited about this opportunity but don’t check every box, we’d love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success. If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements? Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We’ll be thrilled to receive your application! 🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info. You want to know more about Alan? 🙌 Perks & Benefits : Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 🤘 A strong culture : People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work

review_candidates.title: Neidorff Family/Centene Corporation Endowed Professor in International Business
review_candidates.description: Job Family Group: Faculty Time Type: Full time Department/Office: Business Administration Exemption Status: Exempt Job Description: The Department of Business Administration at Trinity University invites applications for the position of Neidorff Family/Centene Corporation Endowed Professor of International Business, effective August 2027. The successful candidate will possess near-native proficiency in a second language (Mandarin preferred), business experience in China or Asia, provide high-quality classroom instruction in the International Business Major, and demonstrate the ability to maintain an impactful research agenda. BACKGROUND Trinity University is a secular, independent, private institution, founded in 1869. Trinity offers high-quality science, liberal arts, and pre-professional programs as represented by the four schools (STEM, Arts & Humanities, Social Science and Civic Engagement, and Business) to approximately 2,500 undergraduate students from the U.S. and more than 45 countries. The attractive campus overlooks downtown San Antonio, a city rich in heritage and ethnic diversity. Additional information can be found on the Resource Guide to Trinity & San Antonio. At the Neidorff School of Business at Trinity University, innovation meets impact. Located in the 7th largest city in the United States, where we’re redefining what it means to deliver a modern business education with bold ideas, ethical leadership, and global perspective coming together. Our AACSB-accredited programs - ranked #1 among undergraduate business schools in Texas and #27 in the nation - empower students to think strategically, lead confidently, and make ethical decisions grounded in data and purpose. Our faculty are mentors, teacher-scholars, and catalysts for transformation. The Neidorff School thrives on collaboration across disciplines, forging powerful connections with humanities, social sciences and STEM disciplines. With cutting-edge facilities, strong industry partnerships, and a student-centered culture that prizes creativity and inclusion, Neidorff is a dynamic hub for shaping the next generation of business leaders who make a difference in the world. Join us, and be part of a school that’s driven by purpose, powered by people, and poised for the future. The Department of Business Administration is one of the three departments housed in the Neidorff School of Business. Home to innovative scholars and industry-connected faculty, the department advances leadership, marketing, and global business through collaborative teaching, mentorship, and applied learning. We develop ethical, well-rounded leaders through an interdisciplinary, integrated business education. Majors in the department include business administration, human resources management, international business, and marketing, and houses courses in business law and strategic management. Our students learn business by doing business. They research alongside faculty mentors, intern with local organizations, study abroad, serve the San Antonio community, attend industry conferences, participate in consulting projects, and enter case competitions, all while gaining valuable skills and experience. Both the Department of Business Administration and the University as a whole value and safeguard academic freedom for faculty members in their teaching and scholarship. Trinity is guided by a set of core values and is committed to implementing practices in pursuit of an inclusive campus for all students, faculty, and staff to feel welcomed and engaged in a community of learning. Duties And Responsibilities Teach three courses with emphasis on international business, and specifically business in China or Asia, every academic year. Primary teaching responsibility is in the area of undergraduate International Business Strategy, Global Business Culture, and International Business Environment. Engage in research activities that result in ongoing scholarly and/or professional publications. Be actively involved in professional organizations and activities. Participate in Departmental, School, and University service activities. Support and encourage recruitment activities associated with our international business program. Advise and counsel students. Qualifications EDUCATION Required: To be considered for this position, applicants should hold a Doctoral Degree in International Business or a closely related field from a program accredited by AACSB, Equis, or AMBA. Experience Required: Near-native proficiency in a second language (Mandarin preferred) Business experience in China or Asia. An established track record of impactful, high-quality scholarly research in international business Preferred: Commitment to future research productivity. Evidence of commitment to high quality classroom performance at the undergraduate level. Understanding of the Trinity mission with an interest in interdisciplinary teaching and engagement. Demonstrated collegiality, respect, and empathy for the inclusion of diverse stakeholders. ATTENDANCE This is an in-person position, not online or remote. How To Apply For internal applicants, please apply through Workday using the 'Jobs Hub' application, see instructions provided here . For external applicants, when starting the application, select "Apply Manually.” Only complete fields with a red asterisk, which are required. Please create your Workday application account using a personal email address, as you will need to maintain access to this account throughout the pre-hire process, if selected. For all applicants, you do not need to complete the “(Work) Experience,” “Education,” “Certifications,” or “Languages” fields - these details will be provided in your curriculum vitae. In the “Application Documents” field, please upload the following as seen below. File 1: Cover Letter including a statement on why the candidate is interested in teaching at Trinity University. File 2: Curriculum vitae; names and contact information for three professional references (they will only be contacted if you are one of the finalist candidates). File 3: Statement of the candidate's teaching philosophy and qualifications and most recent teaching evaluations. File 4: Other materials of the candidate’s choosing, combined in a single pdf file. File 5: Intentional inclusion statement - Intentional Inclusion is a core value at Trinity University. Please provide a brief (1-2 page) reflection on the ways that you might contribute to cultivating an environment where people feel welcomed, respected, and empowered to reach their full potential. Provide examples of how that relates to your teaching, research/scholarship and other professional activities. CONTACT INFORMATION Dr. J. Charlene Davis, Professor of Marketing, Chair of the Department of Business Administration, cdavis2@trinity.edu Dr. Mario V. Gonzalez, Professor of Marketing, mgonza13@trinity.edu Please ensure that all required documents are uploaded prior to submitting an application. If you have revisions needed to an application already submitted or need help submitting an application, please contact Human Resources at 210-999-7507 or email humanresources@trinity.edu.

review_candidates.title: Money Laundering Reporting Officer
review_candidates.description: The Chief Compliance Officer & MLRO is a senior executive role responsible for establishing, overseeing, and continuously enhancing the compliance, Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Counter Terrorist Financing (CTF), and Sanctions framework of the Kazakhstan entity in accordance with the regulatory framework of the AIFC and AFSA. Key Duties & Responsibilities: AFSA Licensing & Controlled Function Liaison Lead all compliance and AML-related workstreams in support of the organization’s AFSA license application, including preparation, review, and submission of mandatory regulatory filings and Approved Individual application forms. Serve as the designated Approved Person (Compliance Officer & MLRO) and primary regulatory contact with the Astana Financial Services Authority (AFSA) and the Financial Monitoring Agency (FMA/FIU) of Kazakhstan. Ensure full compliance with AFSA Fit & Proper criteria and ongoing regulatory obligations under AIFC Financial Services Framework Regulations (FSFR), General Rules (GEN), Conduct of Business Rules (COB), and AML Rules. Attend regulatory interviews with AFSA and participate in all joint workstream sessions with external regulatory advisors. Compliance Framework, AML/CTF & Sanctions Operations Design, implement, and maintain a comprehensive compliance management and AML/CTF framework tailored to AIFC regulations while integrating parent group international brokerage standards. Establish robust KYC, Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), and Sanctions screening protocols for retail and institutional client onboarding. Oversee transaction monitoring mechanisms and lead mandatory reporting of Suspicious Activity Reports (SAR/STR) to the local FIU / Financial Monitoring Agency of Kazakhstan in compliance with local laws. Develop, review, and update internal compliance manuals covering Conflict of Interest, Market Conduct, Personal Account Dealing, Client Suitability, and Client Asset Segregation (CAM Rules). Risk Management, Audit & Board Reporting Establish a continuous compliance monitoring and testing program to proactively identify and remediate regulatory risks. Report directly and regularly to the CEO and Board of Directors on compliance matters, regulatory updates, AML metrics, and material breaches. Maintain and update the Compliance Risk Register, escalating critical issues to executive leadership promptly. Qualifications & Requirements: Residency & Regulatory Eligibility Location & Citizenship: Based in Kazakhstan (Astana preferred). Kazakhstani Nationals or individuals holding valid AIFC Work Residency are strongly preferred. AFSA Approval: Must satisfy AFSA Fit & Proper criteria to be successfully registered as an Approved Person (CCO & MLRO). Prior AFSA approval is a significant advantage. Education & Certifications Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or related discipline. LLM or MBA is a plus. International Compliance Association (ICA) Diploma, CISI Compliance, or equivalent. Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS) strongly preferred. Experience & Skills 7–10+ years of progressive compliance/legal/AML experience within financial services, capital markets, or brokerage firms. Direct experience within an AIFC/AFSA regulated entity or other international common law regulators (e.g., HK SFC, UK FCA, UAE DFSA/ADGM). Professional fluency in English and Russian (written and spoken) is mandatory. Working knowledge of Kazakh for regulatory filing purposes is highly advantageous.

review_candidates.title: Materials Manager
review_candidates.description: Location: Annapolis, Maryland, on site, with regular travel to our Ashburn, Virginia warehouse Reports to: Controller Team: Three direct reports: an order entry and purchasing coordinator and two warehouse leads Type: Full-time, exempt Pay: $105,000 to $125,000 base salary, depending on experience, plus an annual discretionary bonus About us ACG Systems designs, installs and supports radio and communications systems for federal agencies, airports, airlines and commercial customers. Its sister company Morcom designs and installs in-building wireless and electronic security systems. The companies are moving onto one NetSuite system and one shared back office. The role You will build the materials function for ACG Systems and Morcom and own it end to end: what we buy, what we hold, what it is worth on the books, and how orders and items enter NetSuite. This is a new role with a direct line to the Controller, two warehouses and a system going live, so the standards you set are the ones the companies will run on. What you will own Inventory and its accounting • Inventory accuracy at both warehouses: cycle counts, the year-end count and its cut-off, and no negative stock. • The monthly inventory reconciliation, tying the item valuation to the general ledger at both companies. • Month-end inventory entries for the Controller to approve and post: goods received but not billed, goods shipped but not invoiced, the slow-moving reserve and count adjustments. • Correctly classify items on sales orders by type, including services, inventory items and ancillary parts. Understand how each item type flows through the general ledger, from creation on the sales order, through inventory or work in progress where applicable, to relief to cost of goods sold when revenue is recognized. Organize the warehouse so that inventory can be traced to specific bin or shelf locations, and to customer sites where applicable. Process transfers of items between locations, keeping on-site warehouse inventory clearly separated from inventory held offsite. • Customer-owned and demo equipment kept separate from company stock. Items and NetSuite • The item catalog for both companies: written standards for item type, naming, manufacturer part numbers, units of measure, preferred vendor and cost, and approval of every new item. • Cleanup of duplicate items, services set up as stock, and items no longer in use. • The NetSuite set-up for items, locations, purchasing and inventory, including the costing method, agreed with the Controller. Purchasing • Purchasing policy: approval levels, preferred vendors, terms, and combined buying across both companies. • Every purchase order tied to a sales order or approved stock, with a current promised date. • A published availability and backorder report for sales and project managers. The team • Lead and train the order entry and purchasing coordinator and the two warehouse leads. Write the order release checklist and the receiving standard, review work until accuracy is consistent, and coach to the standards. Accounting approves and posts inventory entries, and handles invoicing, vendor payments, and vendor and customer records. Your first 90 days • Walk both warehouses and the stock with the warehouse leads. • Publish the item standard and the order release checklist, and start reviewing every new item and order. • Prepare the first NetSuite inventory reconciliation with the Controller. • Set the cycle count calendar for both sites. What success looks like in the first year • Inventory on the books matches the count at both companies, with a written cut-off, and the reconciliation ties every month. • Cycle counts run on schedule, and no item shows negative stock. • Orders and new items are right the first time, and duplicate and misclassified items are cleaned up. • Every purchase order ties to a sales order or approved stock, with a current date. Requirements • 7 or more years in materials management, inventory control, or inventory or cost accounting at a distributor, systems integrator or contractor, including at least 2 years leading others. • At least 2 years hands-on in NetSuite inventory and purchasing: item records, locations, item receipts, costing method, inventory adjustments and saved searches. • Inventory accounting: perpetual inventory, cost relief when revenue is recognized, matching purchase orders to receipts and bills, month-end accruals, slow-moving reserves, and reconciling the item valuation to the general ledger. • A degree in accounting, finance or supply chain, or equivalent experience. • Writes clear standards and trains people to them. Strong Excel skills. Preferred • Led the inventory or purchasing side of a NetSuite implementation. • Project-based inventory, where job materials are held until delivery or customer acceptance. • Federal orders: GSA Schedule, NASA SEWP, CLINs and IUID marking. • Inventory across more than one site or company. Benefits Medical, dental and vision coverage, with the company paying most of the premium; a 401(k) with a 3% company contribution, fully vested; and paid time off. This position requires a background check. ACG Systems is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

review_candidates.title: Manager: Commercial Performance and Business Intelligence
review_candidates.description: Job Description Job Description Commercial Intelligence — Enterprise Division Reports to: BIPM Executive / Head of Commercial Intelligence Direct reports: Data / Financial Analysts x2 Division: Commercial Intelligence — Enterprise Division ROLE PURPOSE The Manager: Commercial Performance and Business Intelligence is responsible for building and maintaining the analytical infrastructure that supports commercial decision-making across the consolidated commercial and procurement functions. This role translates large volumes of transactional, financial, and operational data into actionable intelligence, enabling the Head of Commercial Intelligence and the broader team to make evidence-based decisions on content procurement, pricing, stock management, and customer/supplier/ product performance. The Manager also supports the development of dashboards, reporting frameworks, and data governance standards. This role also acts as the primary assessment gate between content acquisition and supplier/ customer approval, ensuring that no content, customer or supplier is onboarded or maintained that does not meet defined strategic and financial performance thresholds. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain BI dashboards and reporting tools that provide real-time visibility into content performance, stock levels, GP contribution, and treasury positions. Analyse transactional data across all content categories — airtime, data, bill payments, electricity, and vouchers — to identify trends, anomalies, and commercial opportunities. Provide data-driven input into the commercial assessment gate process, supporting the Procurement Manager and BIPM Executive with financial modelling and scenario analysis. Evaluate the financial viability of all current and proposed commercial initiatives and products — including airtime, data, bill payments, prepaid electricity, and vouchers — against GP% targets, WACC thresholds, and margin contribution benchmarks. Develop standardised reporting packs for weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews. Develop standardised profit and loss reports per customer, supplier, content category, etc. to drive commercial decision-making. Partner with the Senior Manager: Content Procurement to provide supplier performance analytics and stock utilisation and pricing insights on a regular basis. Maintain data integrity across all BI systems and ensure alignment with finance and operational reporting. Lead and develop a team of two Data / Financial Analysts. Champion data governance standards and work with technology teams to improve data pipelines and system integrations. Produce ad hoc analysis as required by the Head of Commercial Intelligence, the Pricing Manager, or senior leadership. Stay abreast of market trends across MNOs, aggregators, electricity distributors, and voucher providers. Minimum Requirements Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Finance, or a related field. Minimum 5 years' experience in a business intelligence, data analytics, or financial reporting role. Proficiency in BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms. Strong SQL skills and experience working with large transactional datasets. Strong experience with financial modelling, margin analysis, and cost-of-capital concepts. Tu seras responsable de diverses activités liées à la spécification, au développement, à l’intégration, à la qualification, aux essais et à la certification des systèmes High Lift, notamment les systèmes de becs et volets (slats/flaps), leurs systèmes d’actionnement et de contrôle. Responsabilités Concevoir et faire évoluer l’architecture des systèmes High Lift afin de répondre aux exigences et objectifs de conception de l’aéronef. Définir, valider et vérifier les requis de premier niveau associés aux systèmes High Lift. Participer à l’intégration des systèmes de becs et volets, incluant les systèmes d’actionnement électromécaniques et/ou hydromécaniques, unités de contrôle, capteurs et interfaces avec les autres systèmes de l’aéronef. Préparer les documents de requis, notamment les devis techniques, schémas fonctionnels, Technical Requirements Documents (TRD) et Statements of Work (SOW). Examiner les propositions et livrables des fournisseurs et assurer leur coordination durant les phases de développement, d’intégration et de qualification. Planifier et soutenir les activités de vérification et validation, incluant les essais sur banc, rigs d’intégration, essais sol et essais en vol. Analyser les résultats d’essais, anomalies et non-conformités et coordonner leur résolution avec les équipes multidisciplinaires et les fournisseurs. Veiller au respect des exigences de certification applicables, notamment FAR Part 25 / CAR 525 / EASA CS-25, RTCA DO-160, DO-178, DO-254 et les processus ARP. Participer aux analyses de sécurité système telles que Functional Hazard Analysis (FHA), Fault Tree Analysis (FTA), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) et Common Mode Analysis (CMA). Collaborer avec les équipes commandes de vol, avionique, hydraulique, électrique, structures et essais afin d'assurer l’intégration fonctionnelle et physique du système High Lift. Participer à la préparation des plans de qualification et de certification ainsi qu’aux campagnes d’essais sol et vol. Soutenir les différentes phases du cycle de vie du système, de son développement jusqu’à sa mise en service. Profil Recherché Diplôme universitaire en génie aérospatial, mécanique, électrique ou équivalent ; une maîtrise constitue un atout. Environ 5 ans d’expérience pertinente en systèmes aéronautiques, idéalement dans les High Lift Systems, Flight Controls ou Actuation Systems. Expérience en spécification, conception, intégration, validation, vérification, essais ou certification de systèmes High Lift. Bonne compréhension des architectures slats/flaps et des systèmes d’actionnement associés. Expérience avec des systèmes d’actionnement électromécaniques et/ou hydromécaniques et leurs interfaces avec les systèmes de contrôle. Expérience en développement ou intégration de nouveaux aéronefs constitue un atout. Bonne connaissance des processus ARP4754 et ARP4761 et des outils de gestion des requis. Connaissance des exigences RTCA DO-160 et familiarité avec DO-178 et DO-254. Familiarité avec les processus de certification FAR Part 25 / CAR 525 / EASA CS-25. Expérience en préparation ou exécution d’essais système, essais sur banc, essais d’intégration, essais sol ou essais en vol. Capacité à collaborer efficacement avec des fournisseurs et des équipes multidisciplinaires. Bon esprit d’équipe, initiative, autonomie, sens des responsabilités et jugement technique. Solides capacités de communication, d’analyse et de rédaction technique. Être membre ou admissible à un ordre professionnel d’ingénieurs constitue un atout. Role Overview You will join an aerospace systems engineering group as a systems integrator, with a particular focus on High Lift Systems (HLS). You will be responsible for activities related to the specification, development, integration, qualification, testing and certification of High Lift Systems, including slats and flaps, actuation systems and associated control functions. Responsibilities Design and evolve High Lift System architectures to meet aircraft-level design requirements and objectives. Define, validate and verify top-level requirements associated with High Lift Systems. Support the integration of slat and flap systems, including electromechanical and/or hydromechanical actuation, control units, sensors and interfaces with other aircraft systems. Prepare requirements documentation including technical specifications, system schematics, Technical Requirements Documents (TRD) and Statements of Work (SOW). Review supplier proposals and deliverables and coordinate supplier activities throughout development, integration and qualification phases. Plan and support verification and validation activities, including bench testing, integration rigs, ground testing and flight testing. Ensure compliance with applicable certification requirements including FAR Part 25 / CAR 525 / EASA CS-25, RTCA DO-160, DO-178, DO-254 and applicable ARP processes. Participate in system safety activities including Functional Hazard Analysis (FHA), Fault Tree Analysis (FTA), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) and Common Mode Analysis (CMA). Collaborate with flight controls, avionics, hydraulic, electrical, structures and test teams to ensure successful functional and physical integration of the High Lift System. Participate in the preparation of qualification and certification plans and support ground and flight test campaigns. Support the system throughout its lifecycle, from development through entry into service. Profile Bachelor’s degree in aerospace, mechanical, electrical engineering or equivalent; a master’s degree is an asset. Approximately 5 years of relevant aerospace systems experience, ideally involving High Lift Systems, Flight Controls or Actuation Systems. Experience in specification, design, integration, verification, validation, testing or certification of High Lift Systems. Good understanding of slat/flap architectures and associated actuation systems. Experience with electromechanical and/or hydromechanical actuation systems and their interfaces with control systems. Experience in new aircraft development or integration is an asset. Good knowledge of ARP4754 and ARP4761 processes and requirements management tools. Knowledge of RTCA DO-160 and familiarity with DO-178 and DO-254. Familiarity with FAR Part 25 / CAR 525 / EASA CS-25 certification processes. Experience preparing or performing system, bench, integration, ground or flight testing. Ability to work effectively with suppliers and multidisciplinary engineering teams. Strong teamwork, initiative, autonomy, accountability and technical judgment. Strong communication, analytical and technical writing skills. Membership or eligibility for membership with a professional engineering order is an asset.

review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 岗位职责： 1.桌面运维 负责终端用户软硬件故障处理、系统安装、账号权限配置、远程协助，快速解决日常使用问题，提升用户体验； 负责 IT 固定资产管理和台账维护，做好入库领用、盘点标签、报废及库存管控，保障资产安全可靠； 3)负责 CCTV、门禁等安防系统日常运维、故障处理与权限，确保安全可靠运行； 配合完成新员工 IT 入职支持、日常用户相关 IT 协助工作，提升办公效率； 定期培训新员工和宣传保密制度，确保保密工作执行到位。 系统运维 负责 OA、ERP、企业网盘等业务应用系统日常监控、故障排查与运行保障，保障数据安全； 执行全公司的所有数据，包括：研发/实验/GMP等核心及其他类数据日常备份、定期恢复测试、备份介质管理，保障备份有效性且能按要求恢复； 3）维护运维记录、巡检台账、备份记录、各类工作记录及 SOP 流程文档，提升运维效率。 网络管理 1）负责网络、服务器、机房、弱电间日常巡检、环境监控与设备状态检查、故障排查与记录，保障网络、服务器等核心设备安全可靠运行，避免受到病毒侵害； 2）配合项目完成网络部署、设备上架及基础调试等基建相关工作，确保网络高效可用且符合公司管理要求。 质量管理与GMP合规 按要求完成GMP相关培训，包括质量手册、GMP基础知识、良好记录规范、数据完整性等，并完成岗位培训及上岗资质确认； 严格遵循质量体系文件、SOP及数据完整性要求开展运维工作，确保操作合规、记录完整、可追溯，保障GMP体系完整和合规； 担任 GMP 计算机化系统管理员，完成系统配置、权限管理、数据备份与日常审计核查； 维护运维记录及相关文档，配合完成内部审计、外部检查及合规核查，满足GMP的合规审查。 定期汇报部门中遇到的问题及解决方案，不断提升部门服务能力和管控落地。 领导安排的其他类工作。 任职资格： 计算机或相关专业本科及以上学历本科及以上学历； 2.5年以上IT相关工作经验； 3.3年以上医药行业IT相关经验； 熟练掌握IT基础架构知识，熟悉网络、服务器、桌面运维及机房巡检； 熟悉ERP、OA、MES、QMS、WMS等系统应用和管理等； 执行力强、严谨细致、服从管理。

review_candidates.title: INTERNATIONAL TECHNICAL SALES CONSULTANT
review_candidates.description: Vaga presencial em Florianópolis | 40h semanais | Salário competitivo Porque se juntar a nós: A Dynamox é uma empresa de alta tecnologia que desenvolve soluções inteligentes de monitoramento de vibração, temperatura, corrente e tensão, ajudando equipes de manutenção e confiabilidade a tornarem a indústria mais segura, eficiente e sustentável. Hoje, somos a única empresa mundial na área de manutenção com as certificações internacionais ISO 27001, 27701, 27017 e 27018, além da ISO 9001. Além de processos bem estruturados, acreditamos em pessoas. Aqui, você encontra um ambiente organizado, colaborativo e orientado à melhoria contínua, onde o aprendizado é incentivado e excelência faz parte do dia a dia. Valorizamos quem busca evoluir, inovar e fazer a diferença. Principais responsabilidades do cargo: Desenvolver estratégias comerciais para expandir a presença internacional da Dynamox em mercados estratégicos; Estabelecer e manter parcerias com representantes e distribuidores internacionais, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos da empresa; Preparar roteiros, realizar visitas a clientes e participar de eventos conforme necessário para fortalecer relacionamentos e identificar oportunidades; Monitorar tendências de mercado e concorrência, contribuindo para o aprimoramento das estratégias comerciais; Colaborar com equipes internas (Marketing, Suporte, Exportação e Customer Success) para assegurar uma experiência completa e satisfatória para o cliente; Registrar todas as atividades no CRM, incluindo informações de clientes, contatos e oportunidades de negócios; Elaborar e enviar propostas técnicas e comerciais alinhadas às demandas específicas dos clientes; Contribuir e disseminar práticas de segurança de informação e privacidade de dados confidenciais e restritos, no que diz respeito às rotinas do departamento e empresa. Requisitos: Experiência com setor indústria; Experiência com a área comercial; Língua estrangeira (Inglês e/ou espanhol) nível fluente na parte verbal e escrita. Formação: Ensino médio concluído; Desejável ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Engenharias, Adminstração/ Economia, Comércio Internacional ou correlatas. Benefícios: Cartão multibenefícios: Cartão flexível, facilitando o uso para alimentação/refeição, transporte, lazer, farmácia, entre outros, onde você escolhe como e onde utilizar; Plano de Saúde e odontológico: Plano de saúde e odontológico para o colaborador após o período de experiência; Convênio SESI: Farmasesi e OdontoSesi; Saúde e bem-estar: Convênio GoGood e Wellhub (descontos em academias e atendimento com nutricionistas, psicólogos e outros profissionais de saúde); Cuidados com a ergonomia: Atendimento com fisioterapeuta/osteopata na empresa; Desenvolvimento profissional: Apoio ao crescimento profissional por meio de incentivo financeiro para cursos, formações e certificações; Parcerias: EBAC e Influx; Incentivos financeiros: PLR, gratificação por desempenho, gratificação pela conclusão de formações e por tempo de casa; Conforto e alimentação no escritório: Frutas e café à vontade, além de acesso ao Market4u e Dynamarket; Cultura e clima: Confraternização mensal e ambiente descontraído, sem dress code.

Remove medical equipment from villas and/or call Support Services for pick up of same. Respond to all radio requests in timely manner for guests or staff. Order villa supplies from Support Services in a timely manner to maintain warehouse inventory par levels. Conduct Disney Linen runs. Food & Beverage Remove dirty rags from Food & Beverage outlets. Provide clean rags to Food & Beverage outlets. Qualifications SKILLS, COMPETENCIES, EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE Ability to follow directions. Ability to perform daily functions with minimal supervision. Ability to communicate clearly and concisely with guests, co-workers and management. Good decision-making skills to ensure a safe work environment. Ability to operate a motorized vehicle, including battery-operated golf cart. Valid driver's license and clean driving record. Must meet acceptable attendance and punctuality requirements, which are essential functions for the position. High School Diploma Previous experience as a Houseperson, preferred. Bilingual, English and Spanish preferred.

review_candidates.title: Head of Finance - Global
review_candidates.description: Head of Finance - Global Role Overview We are looking for a talent with solid end-to-end finance capability, alongside a business mindset, systematic thinking and tech awareness. This role will be responsible for group finance operations, business performance analysis and finance framework development. The incumbent is expected to master core finance functions including accounting, reporting, taxation, treasury, budgeting and internal control. Meanwhile, you need to deeply understand the business, support management decision-making through data analytics, process optimization and technology adoption, and take ownership of the integrity and final outcomes of finance deliverables. Key Responsibilities Build a robust and reliable financial management framework Oversee group daily accounting, month-end close, financial reporting, taxation, treasury, payment management and audit activities. Ensure accurate bookkeeping, reliable data, standardized and traceable workflows. Strengthen financial data and business analytics capability Establish an analytics framework covering revenue, cost, profit, cash flow and operational efficiency. Proactively identify business risks and issues, and deliver clear, actionable recommendations for leadership decision-making. Improve budgeting and resource allocation mechanisms Lead annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, budget tracking and variance analysis. Evaluate project ROI and input-output performance to support rational capital and resource allocation across the organization. Drive digitalization of finance workflows Map end-to-end processes for accounting, reconciliation, payment, expense reimbursement, budgeting, cost allocation and reporting. Drive implementation of finance systems, BI dashboards, AI tools and automation solutions to boost productivity and mitigate operational risks. Deliver cross-border finance initiatives Collaborate with business, legal, compliance, admin and overseas teams to resolve cross-jurisdictional matters on finance, tax, audit and data governance. Drive deliverables under complex or resource-constrained conditions. Requirements Bachelor’s degree or above, major in Finance, Accounting, Finance, Economics or related disciplines 8–13 years of finance working experience; minimum 5 years of experience in end-to-end finance management, finance BP, business analytics or finance transformation Sound knowledge of accounting, financial reporting, budgeting, treasury, taxation, audit, costing and internal control Proven ability to independently deliver month-end close, financial reporting, business analysis and cross-functional coordination Strong data analytics and commercial judgment, capable of translating financial insights into business actions Track record of owning final deliverables, leading complex initiatives and solving problems with limited resources Practical understanding of finance systems, BI tools, AI, process automation and data-driven management Working proficiency in English for cross-border meetings and written business communication Preferred Qualifications Experience in both professional service firms and in-house corporate finance Exposure to group-level finance, overseas finance, cross-border business or multi-entity finance management Prior experience in FinTech, internet, trading platforms or multinational organizations Hands-on experience in finance system implementation, automated reporting, BI dashboard build-out or finance digital transformation projects Overseas assignment experience or track record of independently running end-to-end finance function in complex environments What We Value Strong foundational finance skill set, capable of independently leading full-cycle finance operations Beyond bookkeeping and reporting: able to spot business issues from numbers and enable data-backed management decisions Willingness to dive into frontline business, proactively take ownership and drive results amid complexity Pragmatic, detail-oriented, and able to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders Open to new technologies and new ways of working, committed to continuously improving the quality and efficiency of finance function For more information, pls contact Lynn @ +86 18688970951; +852 62196810.
